title: Where an entry is in one build of one binary (a row of registry/builds/<build>/<binary>/<top scope>.jsonl)
description: Written by machine, sorted by id, one table a top-level scope of the ids so that two branches adding different entries merge: the id, its RVA, its size and the hash of its masked body. Several ids may share an RVA (the linker folds identical code); an id appears once. registry/README.md.

size.description: Bytes, a function's split-off parts included.

body.description: SHA-256 of the body with every placement-dependent byte masked, and of the mask (Registry/Fingerprint.cs); left out below 64 bytes or 16 instructions.
